Common.Main.Scenarios.Basic.Title: Test drive
Common.Main.Scenarios.Basic.Description:
Build the skills you need to use Positive Technologies products. 
Training scenarios based on real-world cases and attack investigations help you explore product features and advanced capabilities in realistic conditions
Common.Main.Scenarios.CTF.Title: Capture the flag
Common.Main.Scenarios.CTF.Description:
Improve your SOC analyst skills, enhancing accuracy and decision-making speed. 
Investigate attack chains, analyze security events and real incidents, and identify associated indicators of compromise
Common.Main.Scenarios.Realtime.Title: Real-time attack
Common.Main.Scenarios.Realtime.Descripti:
Test your skills against a complex attack unfolding in real time. 
Within a limited timeframe, locate all required artifacts and follow the response playbook to stop the attacker, eject them from your infrastructure, and secure critical systems, preventing any actions that would be unacceptable for your organization
